proposals.description: Correct generic soy-peptone whole identity from the broader FOODON hydrolyzed-vegetable-protein identifier to a local material identity. Preserve source75 unspecified soy digest and all prior catalog/tombstone provenance; do not assign Difco Soytone, Bacto Soytone or Phytone formula to it. Existing branded alias claims require separate complete-owner reconciliation before export. Final correction: Correct the exact campaign MappingEvidence method under issue 1226 to LLM_SUGGESTION; preserve its source and claim. Inherited human/process evidence and ComponentEvidence types are unchanged. Retire five branded or alternative identity aliases on the generic soy-digest owner. The three Phytone-bearing dispositions reuse the bounded coordinator conclusion in issue 1212 comment 6718503130. Separate review of the original kg_microbe Soytone token, Bacto Soytone merge history and manufacturer guide pages 13, 33 and 92 confirms distinct named products and processing; generic soy digest is not their exact product identity. Preserve raw texts, original sources, merge history, occurrence totals, all quarantine holds and the Bacto Soytone tombstone. This does not merge or select the competing W08/W10 owner deltas. Optionally classify the retained Properties metadata tokens as REJECTED_LABEL. Native synonym policy already excludes these texts; this is provenance classification only, with no resolver change, filter change or release blocker. Consolidated parent-grounding successor: Replace the provisional local self-mapping with the supported generic MICRO:0000181 soy peptone identity under MAPPING_SEMANTICS section 3. The complete active term and its BD definition-source discussion describe generic enzymatic soy-flour digest; MediaDive ingredient 75 names Soy peptone with soybean/soymeal synonyms, and the Thermo Fisher guide independently defines generic soy peptones as enzymatic digests of soy flour. This is not an identity assertion for Phytone, Difco/Bacto Soytone or any supplier, enzyme or lot. Do not import the erroneous Hordeum vulgare parenthesis, branded/papaic synonyms, or annotated ash/NaCl numbers. Preserve all prior aliases and five branded/alternative withdrawals, complete original histories, occurrence totals, Bacto Soytone tombstone, source quarantines, sibling/incoming-reference obligations, and physical-form/role/export holds. The inherited Peptic digest of soybean meal alias is not newly supported or approved by this generic term assessment.

proposals.description: Reconcile existing generic Peptone owner to local protein-digest material identity, removing unsupported exact mammalian MICRO0000178 scope. Keep raw plural provenance, all existing role/count/truncated-alias holds and both MicrobeDecoder source-case holds; no new owner or catalog assignment. Final correction: Correct the exact campaign MappingEvidence method under issue 1226 to LLM_SUGGESTION; preserve its source and claim. Inherited human/process evidence and ComponentEvidence types are unchanged. Reject only the incomplete concentration token Peptone (0.01 % as an identity name of generic Peptone. Preserve its original microbedecoder provenance and plural Peptones. Do not invent a missing parenthesis, percent basis or preparation. Eighteen retained historical inbound MICRO:0000178 component references and current proposed components remain a source-level integration dependency; no automatic retargeting is authorized. Consolidated parent-grounding successor: Complete the supported nonidentity family grounding: retain kgmicrobe.ingredient:peptone and use NARROW_MATCH to mesh:D011492 Protein Hydrolysates, with native broadMatch plus the local B1 identity row. The active primary NLM concept M0017860 defines a complex mixture produced by partial or extensive hydrolysis; the manufacturer guide defines generic peptones as water-soluble partial protein hydrolysates and includes plant, yeast or animal material and acid, base or enzyme processing. Assess the direct MeSH Peptones term D010461 before this broader route: its acid-or-enzyme and precipitation criteria are not established for the complete source-unspecified generic scope. MICRO:0000178 adds unsupported mammalian origin, MICRO:0000174 an unverified enzymatic process, and MICRO:0000172 does not establish yeast coverage. Do not select FOODON:03315306 after full OWL inspection reveals an actual member-of food-additive restriction in addition to its SIREN comment; preserve the initial private candidate and NEW01 report as unselected evidence. CHEBI:749541 is a sparse imported molecular-entity class without established whole-mixture scope. MICRO:0000167 is a supported but less specific undefined-mixture option. The MeSH descriptor indexing annotation about therapeutic/nutrient use is not imported as a clinical or assay role. Preserve the two MicrobeDecoder observations, raw plural, rejected truncated token, all previous history/evidence/statistics, provisional roles, source holds and source-specific incoming-reference reconciliation; no owner, source-case or export admission.
